stories.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the data model and contract for representing specialty match accuracy, including NUCC code alignment, match score, and classification (exact, partial, mismatch).

stories.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to compare user condition-derived specialties against provider NUCC taxonomy codes and compute a normalized match score with classification tiers.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Match Accuracy into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose specialty match accuracy results through the evaluate_care_facade, ensuring compatibility with provider detail and evaluation workflows.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
stories.description: Create unit tests for scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty extraction to evaluation output.

stories.title: Handle Multi-Specialty Providers and Edge Cases
stories.description: Implement logic to evaluate providers with multiple NUCC taxonomy codes, including weighting, deduplication, and handling of missing or ambiguous specialty mappings from user input.
